Downtown Core.name: Downtown Core
Downtown Core.description: Civic-center and Hunter Square core with the arena-waterfront entertainment district, historic Mariclare and Medico-Dental building reuse, and adaptive-reuse permitting.

Banner Island & Waterfront.name: Banner Island & Waterfront
Banner Island & Waterfront.description: Banner Island ballpark district and the Weber Point waterfront promenade with stadium-adjacent hospitality licensing and event-economy turnover.

Miracle Mile.name: Miracle Mile
Miracle Mile.description: Pacific Avenue's Miracle Mile with independent restaurants and taprooms, the Fox/Bob Hope theatre block, and the metro's densest on-sale license strip.

University of the Pacific.name: University of the Pacific
University of the Pacific.description: UOP campus and Lincoln Center shopping belt with student-housing turnover, medical-office demand, and steady neighborhood-retail licensing.

Lincoln Village & Park Nine.name: Lincoln Village & Park Nine
Lincoln Village & Park Nine.description: Post-war Lincoln Village tracts east of the El Dorado corridor with renovation-led permitting and neighborhood-market license churn.

Eastland Plaza.name: Eastland Plaza
Eastland Plaza.description: Eastland Plaza and East Harding Way retail node with family-market grocers, strip-lot refurbishment, and off-sale license turnover.

Brookside.name: Brookside
Brookside.description: Brookside planned community west of I-5 with office-park retrofit, Trinity Parkway retail pads, and high-valuation residential permitting.

West Lane & Country Club.name: West Lane & Country Club
West Lane & Country Club.description: Country Club Boulevard commercial spine with the golf-course anchor, westside strip retail, and steady service-business licensing.

Quail Lakes & Heritage.name: Quail Lakes & Heritage
Quail Lakes & Heritage.description: Quail Lakes shopping district and the Heritage planned community with pool/roof permitting and family-restaurant licensing.

Spanos Park.name: Spanos Park
Spanos Park.description: Spanos Park residential-golf community along West Eight Mile Road with new-build tract permitting and clubhouse-adjacent hospitality.

South Stockton & Fairgrounds.name: South Stockton & Fairgrounds
South Stockton & Fairgrounds.description: San Joaquin County Fairgrounds district and the California Street corridor with community-reinvestment permits and neighborhood-market licensing.

El Dorado & South Central.name: El Dorado & South Central
El Dorado & South Central.description: South El Dorado Street spine with taquerias and markets, Wilson Elementary-area infill, and steady small-operator license turnover.

Weston Ranch.name: Weston Ranch
Weston Ranch.description: Master-planned Weston Ranch along Manthey Road with builder-driven new-construction permitting and neighborhood retail pads.

Airport & Arch Road Industrial.name: Airport & Arch Road Industrial
Airport & Arch Road Industrial.description: Stockton Metropolitan Airport and Arch Airport industrial belt with logistics-warehouse permits and cannabis-license adjacency to the southeast.
